text:
maria: Heads-up, propose a short 10-business-day stabilize wave to clear 3 high-impact regressions and ship one low-risk, flaggable UX tweak. Agree?
sohail: Agree. My candidates: embeddings p99 regression, streaming disconnects under burst, quota miscount causing rate-limits.
cassie: Telemetry: embeddings p99 spikes for ~6 orgs over last 72h; two are high-value. Streaming drops during 30-90s traffic bursts. Quota miscount traces to a proxy rule mismatch.
emily: UX tweak idea: lightweight prompt templates with a toggle. Designer effort ~0.5d, dev ~1d if behind a flag. Low risk.
jon: From CS: at least one customer asked for a rollback path before accepting fixes. Recommend owners include explicit rollback in PR description.
sam: Runtime note: embedding model pin can be config-only (~2 business days). If we need cross-region routing changes add another day.
maria: Prioritization rubric: 1) revenue/SLA impact 2) visible regressions 3) rollout complexity 4) recovery steps. Score H/M/L and pick the top three bugs + UX tweak.
sohail: Proposed owners: embeddings = sohail, streaming = cassie, rate-limit = jon, UX = emily. Workflow: triage card -> draft PRs -> small canary -> 48h monitor -> full rollout.
cassie: I'll add a short health-check job to run every 5m during the canary and coordinate on-call rotation.
sam: Quick rollback commands to include in the runbook: `redwood runtime pin --unset model=embedding-v2` and `redwood feature-flag disable prompt_templates`.
maria: Timeline: PRs by EOD Thursday, canary next Mon-Tue, full rollout Wed if healthy. I'll notify impacted enterprise accounts today.
on-call-bot: on-call-bot: Allocated rotation for canary window: sohail + cassie (primary), jon (secondary).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary initiated for thread 1835599999 on prod-a at 2024-11-12T14:05:00Z.
cassie: Canary health looks clean first 6h. Continuing monitoring.
maria: Posting sprint board card now and will paste link here. Owners: please attach rollback steps to PRs and tag reviewers.
